evidence: Reviewed the 26 changed paths against ba8ab2d050. Binary diff SHA-256 9f42d8e13349d83ab382ebe178d9041784d244e59812ad39a000b5f76256c714.

One ALab-owned Autopilot fixture constructs the old Rust error variant. Its assertion requires a fatal outcome for a missing helper. The refactor leaves the existing error category available to analytics clients.
